name: teamhub-ftc
description: Open-source, bring-your-own-services team dashboard for FIRST Tech Challenge teams.

scripts.build: npm run generate && npm run build -w @teamhub/dashboard
scripts.dev: npm run generate && npm run dev -w @teamhub/dashboard
scripts.dev:demo: tsx packages/generator/src/cli.ts generate --config examples/demo.config.json && npm run dev -w @teamhub/dashboard
scripts.build:demo: tsx packages/generator/src/cli.ts generate --config examples/demo.config.json && npm run build -w @teamhub/dashboard
